ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-2,
Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment Districts and indications as shown on Map
No. 18-C in the area bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to East 75" Street; a line 132.65 feet west of and
parallel to South Luella Avenue; East 75" Street; and, a line 55.23 feet east of South
Paxton Avenue

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Common Address:
2206 East 75" Street
